DECLARE
 v_temp NUMBER:=0;
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);

 function check_audit(plUnitId in varchar2) return boolean is
 v_count number:=0;
 begin
 select count(*) into v_count from donations where unit_id=plUnitId and 
 coll_date=:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date 
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and n_audit_flag is not null;
 
 if v_count=0 then
 return false;
 else
 return true;
 end if;
 end check_audit;

BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

IF :ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id is not null then

 If :Global.code_scheme = 'I' then 
 szUnitId:=Substr(:ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id,1,13);
 Else
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id;
 END IF;

 select nvl(count(*),0) into v_temp from donations where unit_id=szUnitId and 
 coll_date=:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 IF v_temp=0 then
 show_error('16157');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 if check_audit(szUnitId) then
 pullup_donor_information(szUnitId);
 check_package_failure;
 else

 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id:=null;
 :ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date:=null;
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id','E');
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id');
 show_error('16175');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 END IF;

 synchronize;
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_rollback',enabled,property_true);
 audit_info(szUnitId);
END IF;

END;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHER_FORM_O
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHER_FORM_o (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM ( p_exec_name);
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: UNDO_AUDIT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE undo_audit(pl_trans_id in varchar2) IS
 v_insert_date DATE;
 v_status VARCHAR2(300);
 remove_failure EXCEPTION;
 alert_id number;
 v_reason_des VARCHAR2(50);
 szUnitId VARCHAr2(15);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 

 /* Get the reason from master codes */

 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme='I' then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id,1,13);
 Else
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id;
 End if;

 Begin
 select description into v_reason_des from valid_master_codes where code_type='INTRM' and
 code='WRGEN';
 Exception 
 when no_data_found then
 message('Err: Reason code WRGEN is not available in Master codes table...');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 message(sqlerrm);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 End;

 -- 1. Terminate from donation interdictions

 
 UPDATE donation_interdictions 
 set term_date=chp_sysdate, -- modified from sysdate to chapter sysdate on 05/16/2011;Ashok; 
 release_date=chp_sysdate, -- modified from sysdate to chapter sysdate on 05/16/2011;Ashok; 
 release_user=LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,
 term_reason='WRGEN',
 reason_code='WRGEN',
 comments=v_reason_des 
 where program_id in ('DRIVISNU','DRIREAUD','DRUREAUD','DRIDFAUD','DRUDFAUD') and 
 transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id;

 -- 2. terminate from donor interdictions 


 UPDATE donor_interdictions 
 set term_date=chp_sysdate, -- modified from sysdate to chapter sysdate on 05/16/2011;Ashok; 
 release_date=chp_sysdate, -- modified from sysdate to chapter sysdate on 05/16/2011;Ashok; 
 release_user=LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,
 term_reason='WRGEN',
 reason_code='WRGEN' 
 where program_id in ('DRIVISNU','DRIREAUD','DRUREAUD','DRIDFAUD','DRUDFAUD') and 
 transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id;
 
 -- 3. delete records from health history 

 delete from health_history where transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id;
 
 --4. delete records from physical findings 

 delete from physical_findings where transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id;

 --5. Update donations table 
 
 IF :ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id is not null then -- modified from sysdate to chapter sysdate on 05/16/2011;Ashok; 
 DON_INTER.PLACE_INTER_UNIT(szUnitId,null,:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date,
 :global.chapter_id,:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id,'DRDEF',null,'WRGEN',null,
 LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,null,null,'DRUAUDIT',:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date,chp_sysdate+365,v_status,
 'Audit Rollback');

 if v_status!='OK' then
 show_error('16113','DRDEF');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 End if;

 IF :ctrl_blk_1.d_deferral_id is not null then -- modified from chapter to multichapter 05/16/2011;Ashok; 
 DON_INTER.INTER_UPGRADE_PLACE(:ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id,:global.multi_chapter,null, -- IM:10058 (global variable misspelled) 06/10/2014
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id,'DRDEF',null,'WRGEN',LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,
 null,null,'DRUAUDIT',:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date,null,
 'Audit rollback', v_status);
 
 if v_status!='OK' then
 show_error('16113','DRDEF');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 End if;


 :system.message_level:=10;
 COMMIT_FORM;
 :system.message_level:=0;

 if :ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id is not null then
 AUTOMATIC_INTERFACE(szUnitId,:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date) ;
 :system.message_level:=10;
 COMMIT_FORM;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 end if;

 
 Update donations set n_audit_flag=null,n_audit_user=null,n_audit_date = null where
 transaction_id=:ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id; 
 
 :system.message_level:=10;
 COMMIT_FORM;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 
 do_key('clear_form');
 synchronize;
 set_alert_property('inform_alert',alert_message_text,'Rollback is complete . Please Audit again ');
 alert_id:=show_alert('inform_alert');
 
EXCEPTION 
 when others then
 message('System could not undo the audit information - Contact IS');
 check_package_failure; 
END;

PROCEDURE pullup_donor_information(plUnitId in varchar2) IS
 v_transaction_id VARCHAR2(10);

 v_don_type VARCHAR2(5);
 v_proc_code VARCHAR2(5); 
 v_name VARCHAR2(150); 
 v_dob DATE;

 v_h_phone VARCHAR2(7); 
 v_d_area VARCHAR2(3);

 v_city VARCHAR2(100);
 v_state VARCHAR2(2);
 v_zip VARCHAR2(7);
 v_sign VARCHAR2(1);
 v_extension NUMBER;
 v_coll_date DATE;
 v_n_audit_date DATE;
 v_tran VARCHAR2(10);
 v_prog_id VARCHAR2(16);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 

 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_don_def='DON' then
 select transaction_id,program_id into v_tran,v_prog_id from donations where unit_id=plUnitId
 and coll_date=:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date;
 else
 select transaction_id,program_id into v_tran,v_prog_id from donations where deferral_id=:ctrl_blk_1.d_deferral_id
 and coll_date=:ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date;
 end if;

 
 IF v_prog_id in ('ONILKREG','ONPLKREG') then 
 clear_form(no_validate);
 initialise_windows;
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_rollback',enabled,property_false);
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_don_def');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.f_unit_id','E');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date','E');
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.d_deferral_id','E');
 show_error('21107');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 
 -- Added by Kishore on 08/23/2013. IM 9589
 -- Removed DONOR_ADDRESSES and VALID_CITY_STATE tables from above query.
 -- Looks like they were not serving any purpose
 select a.n_audit_date, a.transaction_id, a.donor_id, a.donation_type, a.procedure_code,
 a.donor_signature_flag, b.last_name || ', ' || b.first_name || ' ' || b.middle_name,
 b.date_of_birth, b.gender 
 into v_n_audit_date, v_transaction_id, v_donor_id, v_don_type, v_proc_code,
 v_sign, v_name,
 v_dob, v_gender
 from donations a, donors b
 where a.transaction_id = v_tran 
 and a.coll_date = :ctrl_blk_1.s_collection_date 
 and b.donor_id = a.donor_id;
 -- End of change

 :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id:=v_transaction_id;

 :ctrl_blk_1.s_name:=v_name;

 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_dob:=v_dob;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_sex:=v_gender;
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_transaction_id:=v_transaction_id;

 :ctrl_blk_1.s_donor_id:=v_donor_id; 

 END IF; 
EXCEPTION when others then
 handle_error;
 null;
END;

PROCEDURE automatic_interface(pl_unit_id in varchar2, pl_coll_date in date) IS
 p_interface_id varchar2(10);

 p1_interface_id varchar2(10);
 chp_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 p_interface_id := null;
 n_interface_id := null;
 p1_interface_id := null;
---

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 DELETE from unit_interdictions
 WHERE unit_id = pl_unit_id
 AND chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 AND coll_date = pl_coll_date
 AND inter_code in ('HOLD', 'RHLD', 'RNFT', 'DEFR', 'PDEF', 'TDEF','ELIG')
 AND program_id = 'DNLBU';
 
---
 UPDATE units
 SET donor_lab_dats = null,
 nursing_audit_flag = null,
 nursing_audit_status = null
 WHERE unit_id = pl_unit_id
 AND coll_date =pl_coll_date
 AND chapter_id =:global.chapter_id;
---


 -- Added for SCR: 19255 LT 2013 
 INSERT INTO AUDIT_RESET (UNIT_ID, DEF_ID, INSERT_DATE, CHAPTER_ID) VALUES(pl_unit_id,null,chp_sysdate,:GLOBAL.chapter_id); -- the trigger in this table call the interface



 --DNLBU.donor_to_lab_unit_data (pl_unit_id, :global.chapter_id, null, null, p_interface_id); 
 --don_lab_nai.interface_nursing_audit(pl_unit_id, null, null, :global.chapter_id, n_interface_id); 
 --CMVINT.donor_to_lab_unit_data(pl_unit_id, :global.chapter_id, null, null, p1_interface_id);
 
EXCEPTION when others then
 message(substr(sqlerrm,1,50)|| ' System could not perform Lab interface ...');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
END;
